_readme: Reversible policy overlay (version 2). Operator directive 2026-09-25: collect all raw data regardless of licence; a licence decides the materialized use view, never collection. Each rule has effects {collection, default_corpus}: collection 'deny' keeps the matching rows unfetched (their held bytes and provenance stay; their backends must be disabled with a policy-blocked reason); default_corpus 'deny' keeps them out of the default corpus/ view, classifying them 'policy-held' (collection/policy-held/). Every matching rule is evaluated; a deny from any of them wins. Access restrictions (WAF, ToS bulk-download prohibitions, robots) are separate from licence and stay collection denies or host suspensions.

jstage_aij_reuse_rights.reason: J-STAGE free access is not a blanket reuse license. Its terms require copyright-holder approval for duplication or derivative databases and prohibit mechanical large-volume download. Exclude existing rows pending verified per-article reuse rights.
jstage_aij_reuse_rights.collection_reason: J-STAGE's terms also prohibit mechanical large-volume download: bulk collection stays held under the 2026-09-25 collect-all directive (only the reuse-only part of this rule is a licence question).

soep_docs_all_rights_reserved.reason: Spawn of EnergyPlus (SOEP) design documentation at lbl-srg.github.io/soep is marked '© Copyright (c) All rights reserved' in its page footer and its source repository (lbl-srg/soep) carries no LICENSE file, so the three crawled pages registered as `open` have no open grant. Exclude them pending a rights grant from LBNL; provenance rows stay intact.
soep_docs_all_rights_reserved.collection_reason: Absence of a reuse grant is a licence question: collected under the 2026-09-25 collect-all directive, held out of the default view (policy-held).

openstudio_coalition_site_no_grant.reason: The 17 openstudiocoalition.org pages (source openstudio-docs) were registered as `open`, but the site grants no licence for its authored documentation: its 'Software License' page licenses only the OpenStudio Application and SketchUp Plug-in software under BSD-3, and the site repository (openstudiocoalition/openstudiocoalition.github.io) has no LICENSE file. OpenStudio material with a real grant (BSD-3 repository docs under gh_openstudio, gh_openstudio-standards, gh_openstudio-hpxml) is NOT covered by this rule.
openstudio_coalition_site_no_grant.collection_reason: Absence of a reuse grant is a licence question: collected under the 2026-09-25 collect-all directive, held out of the default view (policy-held).

proprietary_internal_pointers.reason: Pointer-only records (standards, vendor catalogue pages) with no obtainable public full text: never fetched. This is an ACCESS outcome carried over from the old pointer-only licence, not a licence prohibition: rows whose URL serves public bytes move to license 'proprietary' (collected, classified) through the reviewed pointer-transition in scripts/audit_licence_evidence.py (phase 2). Logins, paywalls and paid downloads are never worked around.

google_patents_cn_translations.note: Operator reviewed the maintainer's 2026-08-25 rights call and directed that this restriction be disregarded, restoring the translated CN patent rows to the training-ready corpus and re-enabling find_patents_cn. Recorded here so the decision is auditable and is not silently re-applied by automated maintenance; re-restricting requires a new operator decision.

previous_rule.reason: Google identifies non-English Google Patents /en content as translated, and its terms effective 2026-07-30 prohibit using AI-generated service content to develop machine-learning models. Preserve provenance, but use neither the translated payload nor future fetches for training.
